spec2def(iccvid.dll iccvid.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# iccvid.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/iccvid-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(iccvid_shims OBJECT iccvid.c)
target_link_libraries(iccvid_shims PRIVATE wine libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(iccvid_shims)
add_cargo_module(iccvid iccvid-cargo iccvid.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS iccvid_shims psdk)
